facts: The Park includes the 1271m summit of kunanyi / Mount Wellington; the Pinnacle can be reached by shuttle, car, bike or on foot subject to conditions. Location: opening park description and Discover.

At research time an official notice announced Pinnacle Road closure on 16–19 November 2026, no vehicle access to the summit, and no pedestrians or cyclists on the closed road. Lower section open to The Springs only on 18–19 November. Location: PINNACLE RD ANNUAL MAINTENANCE CLOSURE.

Visitors are told to check weather, prepare, leave a plan and turn back if in doubt. Snow may cause congestion and closures. Park closes to all users on Extreme or Catastrophic fire-danger days. Location: page banner and safety notices.
